_note: 學習路徑內容建置第16批 #2／6：單複同形（eng.t_mid.noun.same-form-plural，會考級／中階）。有些名詞單數複數長得一樣、不加 -s：sheep／deer／fish。數量由數字或動詞表示：One sheep is… / Two sheep are…。鐵律：不可寫 sheeps／deers；動詞隨語意單複數變化。誘答以『誤加 -s／主詞動詞單複不一致／誤用冠詞』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix sfp_）。

units.can_do: 我知道有些名詞單數和複數長得一樣、不加 -s（sheep／deer／fish），要用數字或動詞表示數量，且動詞要隨語意的單複數改變（One sheep is… / Two sheep are…）。
units.situation_group: 單複同形名詞 Same-form plurals
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Some nouns have the same singular and plural form and take no -s: 'one sheep', 'two sheep'; the same is true of 'deer' and 'fish'.
claims.verification_ref: sheep/deer/fish 單複同形、複數不加 -s；one sheep/two sheep；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: These nouns do not add -s; forms like 'sheeps' or 'deers' are incorrect — the plural is still 'sheep', 'deer'.
claims.verification_ref: sheeps/deers 錯誤、複數仍為 sheep/deer；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the meaning is singular, the verb is singular: 'One fish is in the tank.'
claims.verification_ref: 一隻用單數動詞 is；One fish is in the tank；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the meaning is plural, the verb is plural: 'Two sheep are in the field.'
claims.verification_ref: 多隻用複數動詞 are；Two sheep are in the field；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Some nouns have the same form in the singular and the plural, so you do not add -s. The three most common are sheep, deer, and fish: one sheep, two sheep. You can tell the number from the word before the noun or the verb after it, but the noun itself does not change.
teach.zh_hint: 有些名詞單數和複數長得一樣，不用加 -s。最常見的三個：sheep（羊）、deer（鹿）、fish（魚）。One sheep, two sheep. 數量看前面的數字或後面的動詞，字形不變。

teach.body: I can see two sheep on the hill.
teach.zh_hint: 我看到山丘上有兩隻羊。sheep 複數也不加 -s。

teach.body: Even though the noun does not change, the verb still changes with the number. Use a singular verb for one: One deer is eating grass. Use a plural verb for more than one: Three deer are running.
teach.zh_hint: 雖然字形不變，動詞還是要隨數量改變。一隻用單數動詞：One deer is eating grass.（一隻鹿在吃草。）多隻用複數動詞：Three deer are running.（三隻鹿在跑。）

teach.body: There is one fish in the bowl.
Never write sheeps, deers, or fishs; these are all wrong. To show a large number, put a number or some / many before the noun and keep the noun the same: many fish, ten deer.
teach.zh_hint: 千萬不要寫成 sheeps／deers／fishs，這些都是錯的。要表示很多，就用數字或 some／many 加在前面，名詞本身不變：many fish、ten deer。

teach.body: Many fish live in the river.
teach.zh_hint: 河裡住著很多魚。many＋fish，動詞用複數 live。

practice.stem: 選正確：I saw three ____ in the field.（我看到田裡有三隻羊）

distractor_rationales.sheeps: sheep 單複同形，複數不加 -s。
distractor_rationales.sheepes: 沒有 sheepes 這個字；複數仍是 sheep。
distractor_rationales.a sheep: a 表示一隻，但這裡是三隻，要用 sheep（不加冠詞 a）。

practice.stem: 選正確：Two deer ____ eating grass over there.（兩隻鹿在那裡吃草）

distractor_rationales.is: 兩隻是複數，動詞要用 are，不用 is。
distractor_rationales.be: 這裡要用有時態的 be 動詞 are，不是原形 be。

practice.feedback: 兩隻＝複數，用 are：Two deer are eating。

practice.stem: 選正確：One fish ____ swimming in the bowl.（一條魚在魚缸裡游）

distractor_rationales.are: 一條是單數，動詞要用 is，不用 are。
distractor_rationales.do: 這裡需要 be 動詞 is 來組成現在進行式，不是 do。

practice.feedback: 一條＝單數，用 is：One fish is swimming。

practice.answer: There are five sheep on the farm.
options: There are five sheep on the farm.
There are five sheeps on the farm.
There is five sheep on the farm.
There are five sheepes on the farm.

sheep 不加 -s；複數仍是 sheep。
五隻是複數，要用 are，不用 is。

practice.feedback: 複數 sheep 不加 -s、動詞用 are：There are five sheep。

practice.stem: 選正確：I counted ten ____ in the forest.（我在森林裡數到十隻鹿）

distractor_rationales.deers: deer 單複同形，複數不加 -s。
distractor_rationales.deeres: 沒有 deeres 這個字；複數仍是 deer。
distractor_rationales.a deer: a 表示一隻，但這裡是十隻，要用 deer（不加冠詞 a）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I can see two sheep on the hill.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：two sheep（複數不加 -s）有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。重音落在數字與名詞上、句尾下收。

lines.text: There are many fish in the lake.
lines.intonation: There are many fish 起、in the lake 句尾下收

lines.text: One deer is standing near the tree.
lines.intonation: One deer is standing 起、near the tree 句尾下收
